What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal household use. The coverage depends on the item and, for warmers, when it was purchased:
Warmers bought before March 20, 2026: one year from purchase.
Warmers bought on or after March 20, 2026: six months from purchase. Registering within 60 days of purchase makes the warmer eligible for a free two-year limited warranty.
Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.
Silicone dishes: six months from purchase.
During the initial warranty period, manufacturer-defective products or parts are replaced at no charge. During the extended limited warranty period, replacements for manufacturer defects are offered at a 50% discount.
The warranty doesn’t cover accidental damage, abuse, neglect, incorrect voltage or power supply, attempted repair, or loss or theft. You can find the warranty details and Return Portal on our Shipping, Warranty & Returns page.
If you tell me which item you have and when you bought it, I can help narrow down which coverage applies.
